scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Dart Flutter client conforming to firebase_storage_platform_interface via Pyric WebSocket bridge and HTTP byte-route transport. Covers PyricFirebaseStoragePlatform delegates & bucket scoping, ReferencePlatform hierarchy & refFromURL, putData/putString/putFile/putBlob upload tasks, getData & writeToFile downloads, tokenized getDownloadURL, FullMetadata & SettableMetadata operations, object deletion, listAll & paginated list(ListOptions), TaskPlatform pause/resume/cancel & snapshotEvents, and Storage Security Rules enforcement.
